What you're describing sounds very distressing, and your confusion is completely understandable. A therapist entering your home while you're medicated and writing down your credit card information is a serious boundary violation and may be illegal, regardless of his intent to repay a loan. The professional therapeutic relationship has clear ethical boundaries, and what you've described crosses them significantly.

I'd encourage you to take some protective steps. Consider contacting your credit card company to flag or monitor your account for unauthorized charges. You can also file a complaint with your state or provincial licensing board that oversees therapists, as they investigate ethical violations. If you believe a crime may have occurred, you can contact local police. It may also help to reach out to a trusted friend or family member who can support you right now as you sort through what happened. Please take care of yourself and prioritize your safety and financial security.
